settings.evidence_representation: conditioned/sliced factors; observed axes removed and scalar factors retained (no change for prior)
settings.label_policy: earliest safe sum; optimizer binary topology retained
settings.query_topology_source: scalar evidence plan; identical binary children, re-canonicalized open output axes; no independent query optimizer run
settings.search_cost_vs_executed_cost: omeco searches its native label-retention work; saved/recounted execution uses earliest-safe-sum labels; these costs need not coincide
